system.description:
Clones Everywhere – Disoriented.

Disoriented is treated as a Mental Condition. Creatures with it are dizzy, off guard and are seeing double, triple or however many of you there are. They suffer the following effects.

Disadvantage on Perception Checks.

Cannot make attacks of opportunity or trigger reactions that would make an attack.

When attempting to target a creature, roll a d20. On a roll of 11 or higher, they target the closest Bunshin instead, even if they are out of the attack, jutsu or features range, causing the attack, jutsu or feature to miss.

This condition ends at the end of an affected creatures turn.
system.summary: Disadvantage on Perception; no attacks of opportunity or attacking reactions; 11+ on a d20 when targeting hits the nearest Bunshin instead.

rules.text: No attacks of opportunity or reactions that attack. When it targets a creature, roll a d20: on 11+ it targets the nearest Bunshin instead and misses.
